newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bavaria Colombia's most active May stock.
newsitem.headline: Bavaria Colombia's most active May stock.

text.p: Brewer Bavaria SA maintained its ranking as Colombia's most actively traded stock in May, the Securities Superintendecy said.

Bavaria, which stands among the world's top eight brewers, has outperformed the market by more than 50 percent in dollar terms so far this year and led most actives in April as well. It was upgraded Friday by ING Barings from hold to buy because of expectations of an increase in operating income and strong second quarter results.
The second most actively traded share on the country's three exchanges in May was Banco de Colombia, Colombia's No. 2 bank in terms of assets.
Third place in the superintendency's ranking of most active May stocks went to cement maker Compania de Cementos Argos of the highly diversified Sindicato Antioqueno industrial group.
Other most actives included retailer Cadenalco SA, another Sindicato Antioqueno holding, and Banco Industrial Colombiano, the conglomnerate's financial arm.
Of 38 firms included on the superintendency's list, 13 belong to the Sindicato.
